description: This file implements the Singleton pattern for managing singleton instances within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It defines methods for listing, registering, unregistering, and disposing singleton objects, including destructor logic and singleton list management.

classes.name: Singleton::SingletonList
classes.description: Manages a list of singleton instances, providing registration, unregistration, disposal, and destructor logic.

methods.name: Singleton::ListInstance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the static singleton list instance.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::~SingletonList
methods.description: Destructor that checks for non-empty list and calls Dispose.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Dispose
methods.description: Deletes all singleton instances in the list.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Register
methods.description: Adds a singleton instance to the list.

methods.name: Singleton::SingletonList::Unregister
methods.description: Removes a singleton instance from the list.
